confidence_notes: Havana's [crowdsourced restaurant prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Havana) are sparse, and shortages and exchange rates add volatility. Cocktail and wine estimates use [reported drink ranges](https://hotelhavanaerror.com/cost-of-a-meal-at-a-paladar-in-cuba-what-youll-really-pay/) and premiums over beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; registered dorm availability is especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Havana price reports. Accommodation estimates draw on Havana's guesthouse market and Caribbean capital cities, adjusted for tourism demand and constrained supply.
